description: This bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two models, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across different query complexities—Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The horizontal axis represents the query complexity categories, labeled “Simple,” “Moderate,” “Challenging,” and “Total” in that order, and is categorical. The vertical axis, labeled “Execution Accuracy,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each complexity level, there are two bars representing the two models: NatSQL is represented by a lighter blue color, and TA-SQL is represented by a darker blue color. For the “Simple” category, NatSQL has an execution accuracy of 63.14, while TA-SQL has an accuracy of 60.21. In the “Moderate” category, NatSQL’s accuracy is 48.60, and TA-SQL’s is 39.64. For “Challenging” queries, NatSQL achieves 36.11 accuracy, and TA-SQL achieves 32.32. Finally, for the “Total” category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 56.19, and TA-SQL has an accuracy of 51.35. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each complexity level, allowing for a visual comparison of the two models’ performance within each category, and are not sorted in any particular order.
